scope: real-device mobile stability, auth/data continuity, drawer, operational pages, Nara
preserved: Nara attachments, camera, photo, microphone, speaker, model and intelligence controls

validation.providerLogin: Must be confirmed against deployed Supabase provider configuration and real callback URLs.
validation.physicalDevices: Static and simulated viewport validation do not replace real-device verification after deployment.
validation.naraMicrophoneClose: Requires interactive browser verification before claiming microphone shutdown on every supported browser.
validation.capacity: Capacity model is a planning simulation only; no 900-million-user claim is made without distributed load testing and provider capacity evidence.

dataPolicy: No fabricated production analytics, member counts, comments, traffic, login success, or capacity claims.
